project1.title: RealStateRD – Web Platform for Appointment Management (Full-Stack)
project1.description: A fullstack web page about a real estate company, allows managing appointments, admin and user login
project1.detailedDescription:
RealStateRD is a complete web platform that helps real estate companies manage their appointments and client interactions efficiently.

What does it do?
This application allows potential clients to schedule property viewings online, while company administrators can manage all appointments, properties, and user accounts from a centralized dashboard. Think of it as a digital reception desk that works 24/7.

Main Capabilities:
• Clients can create accounts and book appointments to view properties
• Administrators have a control panel to manage everything in one place
• The system shows real-time availability to avoid double bookings
• Works perfectly on computers, tablets, and smartphones
• All information is stored securely in a database
• Clean and modern design that's easy to navigate

Business Impact:
This solution eliminates the need for phone calls and manual scheduling, saving time for both clients and staff while reducing booking errors.

Technologies: Built with ASP.NET Core, React, SQL Server, and Tailwind CSS.

project2.title: Fullstack web application for managing Movies
project2.description: Fullstack web application for managing Movies, allows managing Movies, admin and user login
project2.detailedDescription:
A complete movie catalog management system that works like a digital library for films, allowing users to explore and administrators to manage the entire collection.

What does it do?
Imagine Netflix's catalog management system - this application allows users to browse movies, search by different criteria, and view detailed information. Administrators can add, edit, or remove movies from the catalog and manage user access.

Main Capabilities:
• Users can search and filter movies by title, genre, year, or rating
• Detailed movie pages showing all relevant information
• Secure login system for users and administrators
• Admin panel to add new movies or update existing ones
• Organized categorization making it easy to find specific types of movies
• Works seamlessly on any device (desktop, tablet, or phone)

Business Impact:
Perfect for video rental services, streaming platforms, or any business that needs to manage a large catalog of movies with multiple users.

Technologies: Built with ASP.NET Core, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

project3.title: Task Management System - RESTful API
project3.description: RESTful API for task management. With JWT for authentication, SignalR for real-time notifications and Rx.net for data flow management.
project3.detailedDescription:
A backend system for task and project management, similar to what powers applications like Trello or Asana. This is the 'engine' that runs behind the scenes of a task management application.

What does it do?
This system provides the foundation for a task management application where teams can organize their work, assign tasks, set deadlines, and receive instant notifications. While users don't see this part directly, it's what makes everything work smoothly and securely.

Main Capabilities:
• Handles all task creation, assignment, and tracking operations
• Sends instant notifications when tasks are updated or assigned
• Manages user authentication ensuring only authorized people can access the system
• Allows team collaboration with real-time updates
• Tracks task priorities and deadlines automatically
• Processes multiple requests efficiently without delays
• Provides a secure and organized way for other applications to interact with the data

Business Impact:
This type of system is essential for companies needing to coordinate team work efficiently. It ensures everyone stays updated in real-time and that task information is always accurate and secure.

Technologies: ASP.NET Core, SignalR, JWT, and Rx.net.

project4.title: Landing pages with Html, CSS and JavaScript

What does it do?

Main Capabilities:

• Smooth animations that enhance user experience without being distracting

project5.title: Delicias RD - Elegant Dominican Restaurant
project5.description: Modern and elegant landing page for a high-end Dominican restaurant, designed to showcase the brand and attract customers
project5.detailedDescription:
Delicias RD is a modern landing page created for an elegant Dominican restaurant. This project showcases the ability to build visually stunning, professional websites that capture a brand's essence and convert visitors into customers.

What does it do?
This website serves as the digital storefront for Delicias RD, presenting the restaurant's menu, ambiance, and unique value proposition in an attractive and engaging way. It's designed to make visitors want to visit the restaurant or make a reservation immediately.

Main Capabilities:
• Beautiful, modern design that reflects the elegance of a high-end restaurant
• Fully responsive layout that looks perfect on any device
• Smooth animations and transitions that enhance user experience
• Clean, organized code structure that's easy to maintain and expand
• Fast loading times ensuring visitors don't leave before seeing the content
• Optimized navigation making it easy for customers to find information
• Professional presentation of menu items and restaurant features

Business Impact:
A well-designed restaurant website is essential for attracting customers in today's digital world. This landing page creates a strong first impression, builds trust, and encourages potential customers to visit the restaurant. It demonstrates the ability to create marketing-focused websites that drive real business results.

Technologies: Built with React and Tailwind CSS for a modern, scalable, and maintainable codebase.
